# SerpPrism

> Free SEO and website auditing tools that run entirely in the browser. No upload, no signup.

## Tools
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate clean page title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags. Live length warnings, copy-ready HTML, runs entirely in your browser.
- [SERP Preview Tool](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/serp-preview): Preview how your title and description will look in Google search results, measured in real pixels. See exactly where the snippet gets truncated before you publish.
- [robots.txt Tester](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/robots-txt-tester): Paste a robots.txt and test any URL against any user-agent. See exactly which rule wins, which line matched, and whether Googlebot can crawl the page.
- [Heading Structure Analyzer](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/heading-analyzer): Paste HTML and get a clean H1–H6 outline plus a list of real problems: missing or duplicated H1, skipped levels, and headings that are too long.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/keyword-density): Count single words, two-word and three-word phrases with stopwords filtered out. See actual frequency and percentage, plus which phrases are worth targeting.
- [Readability Score Checker](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/readability-score): Measure Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, sentence length, syllables per word and passive voice. See which sentences are dragging the score down.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/llms-txt-generator): Build a valid llms.txt file for your site — the plain-text index that tells AI crawlers and assistants what your site actually offers. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [JSON-LD Schema Markup Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid JSON-LD structured data for Article, FAQ, HowTo, Product, BreadcrumbList and Organization. Fill in fields, get copy-ready markup that validates.
- [UTM Link Builder](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/utm-link-builder): Build campaign URLs with correctly encoded utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term and utm_content. Live validation catches the mistakes that split your analytics data.
- [Open Graph Preview Tool](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/open-graph-preview): Preview the card LinkedIn, Facebook, X and Slack will render for your link, and get the Open Graph and Twitter tags that produce it. Flags the image mistakes that make shares render as a grey box.
- [hreflang Tag Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/hreflang-generator): Generate hreflang annotations as HTML link tags, an HTTP Link header, or XML sitemap entries — with real validation for bad language codes, duplicate entries and the missing return tag.

## Guides
- [Meta Description Length: What Actually Gets Truncated](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/meta-description-length): The number everyone quotes is 155 characters. The real rule is pixel width, and knowing the difference saves you from rewriting descriptions that were fine.
- [robots.txt Mistakes That Silently Deindex Pages](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/robots-txt-mistakes): Five configuration errors that remove pages from Google without producing any error message anywhere.
- [Heading Structure: What H1–H6 Order Actually Does](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/heading-structure-seo): Headings are document structure, not a ranking lever. Here is what they genuinely affect, and what is folklore.

## Notes for automated readers
All processing is client-side JavaScript. There is no API; tool behaviour is deterministic given the same input.
